objective: First Genesis staging Android APK MUST include real Godot Android AAR and bundled procedural Kingdom scene, Media3 Transformer, Play Core in-app update, and Google Drive Android OAuth SDK, while keeping production/old staging intact.
productionBaselineEvidence: main 551e54602addd6f7bbe7bcdddd1589d35424c964 (checked Nov 20 earlier); Genesis native source bd4a601ac619b077f6544c425821e8c08542625e, signed Genesis APK does not exist. This branch edits no production/main/Backend, and uses separately gated staging only.
chosenApproach: One isolated combined Expo native Kotlin bridge in the existing autolinked IME Android module; Maven pinned Godot, Media3, Play Core and Play Services Auth, 3-file original Godot ZIP bundled by preview-only config plugin, native launch button; source-only compile and negative release tests.
selectionRationale: All four native binary APIs must be compiled in FIRST signed Genesis staging runtime; future compatible JS and media can use these SDKs via OTA, avoiding repeat APK. No placeholder native SDK claims. Require real signed artifact and device proof before release.
alternativeApproaches: Ship missing SDKs later via OTA (impossible for native ABI)
Use production Supabase to bypass isolated stage credentials (rejected)
Declare native dependencies without a compiled bridge or Godot project pack (rejected)
Merge outdated native lab wholesale (rejected due ancestry and security regression risk)
preserveBehaviors: First-view AdMob and tab navigation preserved by untouched providers and feature gate
Existing BUKLOD main production runtime 1.3.2 unaffected
Older staging-user OTA and backend/finance/rewards unchanged

Godot rendered in separate Android process with no points, store, finances, or telemetry
